notes.note: index.css change in this branch is only the keyboard focus-visible rule: the ring follows --accent-primary, and follows --k-focus under data-brand-focus (a white-label theme that sets focus) or on a Dev, Beta or Nightly build. With no device accent the painted ring is unchanged (cascade test and before/after screenshots). This document makes no claim about focus ring colour.

Checked the accepted shape and threshold table against branding-theme.ts after the swap to validateBrandOverride, including where Station is stricter than the shared rule (action on panel, brand on page). The focus-ring bullet is back to main's wording (a theme's or a Dev, Beta or Nightly build's --k-focus wins, the device accent otherwise), which the data-brand-focus marker in applyBrandingTheme and the index.css focus rule make true with ui 1.16.0. Added two rules checked against branding-theme.ts and branding-theme.test.ts: a flat value that a mode object replaces must still be #rgb/#rrggbb or the theme is rejected (shadowedFlatViolations), and a mode that sets --k-brand without either action property uses the brand as its action with --k-brand-contrast or the shipped action contrast, so the brand must pass the action rules too.
